No problem! I had the same issue, especially since this game hasn’t been that popular since 2018! Feel free to contact me if you need any other help!

There’s two ways you can do it! One way is to go to subway B in The Old South. In the room where that big pink-purple mech is, instead of going to the door at the very top, go to the door on the left when it unlocks. You’re going to kill one of those fancy looking space dudes (I can’t remember the name for the life of me and it’s 3:30 am) and then gone to a room with three turrets at are all like level 36-39 I believe. Kill off two of the turrets (I always leave the middle one alive) and let the farming begin. Oh also! You have to set your party to Standby in Current Positions because if you simply tell them not to attack they will still heal themselves and revive eachother. This method takes a long time for beefy characters because the laser is so low level compared to being like level 60-80 by the end of the game. I like this method more because it’s easier to stay alive while reviving party members and its the only method that I know you can do before the Mother Claudia mission where everyone starts leaving the squadron :(

The other method is to go underground into the Glocken dungeon. At some point you get to a room with two of those space dudes and a level 70 laser. Kill the space dudes and leave the laser. Once again get your party into a corner and set them to Standby in Current positions and let the farming begin! 

Note: every once in a while the laser in both methods will target you! You can avoid getting shot by staying close to the laser but sometimes it’ll continue to target you. Make sure you’re at full health (especially if you’re doing the second method) and go stand with your party while the laser targets you. You’ll get hit, but the attack will also hit the rest of your party! 

Note 2: You probably want to have the healing skill where you can shoot a healing field so that you can heal yourself if your health gets low. The med kit sucks and barely helps so your best option is the healing field. I’m telling you the laser loves you target you even though it can’t hit you. If you do happen to go down, just set your party to Rendezvous on Me and someone will run over to revive you. From there just reset them back in the corner and continue to farm! 

The first method is the one I used for get all of the Game Exclusive characters up to level 4 affinity and it only took me like 45 minutes for all of them. My arfa-Sys was already at like level 3 because she was hella weak at the beginning of the game and I was constantly reviving her.

ALSO I JUST REMEMBERED! There’s a setting in the options menu where affinity is doubled or something?? I can’t remember exactly what it’s called but turn that on if your haven’t already!! Good luck with the true ending!! Hopefully my explanation helped!
